name: CalendarRoot
description: Root of the Calendar compound component, a month view for picking one date or a range of dates. Holds the selected value, the shown month, and the keyboard focus, and passes them to `Calendar.Header` and `Calendar.Grid`. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Day, or `{ start, end }` when `mode` is `range`, selected on first render. Use when the component is not controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.detailedType: ((value: Date | null, eventDetails: Calendar.Root.ChangeEventDetails) => void) | ((value: CalendarRange, eventDetails: Calendar.Root.ChangeEventDetails) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when a day is pressed, with the new day, or the new `{ start, end }` when `mode` is `range`. Call `eventDetails.cancel()` to keep the current value.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected day, or `{ start, end }` when `mode` is `range`. Use when the component is controlled.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Month shown on first render. Defaults to the month of the selected value, or the current month.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the calendar, blocking day selection and month navigation.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used for the month title, weekday names, and day labels.

props.name: mode
props.description: `single` picks one day. `range` picks a first and a last day: the first press sets `start`, the second sets `end` (swapping them if needed), and the next press starts a new range.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, from `0` (Sunday) to `6` (Saturday).

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: CalendarRoot.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
